youtube.title: Why You See Stars When You Rub Your Eyes ✨ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Close your eyes and rub them. You see colours and sparks.

But there's no light in there. Your eye's light sensors can be triggered by pressure, not just light. When you press, they fire anyway, and your brain reads it as light. Those sparks even have a name: phosphenes. You're seeing light that doesn't exist.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
